course.title: NumPy Mastery
course.subtitle: Complete Numerical Computing Program
course.tagline: Learn NumPy. Master Arrays. Build Data Science Skills.
course.description: NumPy from the first array to linear algebra, broadcasting, memory layout, random simulation and real Data Science workflows. Hinglish explanations, runnable code and ten practice sections per module.
prerequisites: Basic arithmetic and an idea of what a matrix is
outcomes: Create and inspect ndarrays and reason about shape, size, ndim and dtype
Index, slice, reshape and broadcast arrays without Python loops
Use universal functions, aggregation and Boolean masks correctly
Tell a view from a copy and control memory usage
Generate reproducible random data and run Monte Carlo simulations
Solve linear systems and choose stable linear-algebra routines
Read and write numeric data with NPY/NPZ and text files
Handle NaN, infinity and masked arrays in real datasets
Vectorise code and benchmark it honestly
Move arrays between NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib and scikit-learn
